observations: Both PS4 and Xbox One local-client mapping functions assign LOCAL_CLIENT_0 and return true without using the controller-index argument.
Both PS4 and Xbox One multiplayer PlayerCmd_IsSplitscreenPlayer implementations return false after validating the player entity.
SV_AddTestClient creates a NA_BOT connection using svs.botport, SV_DirectConnect, and the testClient field.
GScr_AddTestClient forwards to SV_AddTestClient; GScr_SpawnTestClient forwards to SV_SpawnTestClient.
SV_SpawnTestClient sends the game state and enters the test client using a zero-initialized usercmd_s.
SV_ClientThink is downstream of a client slot's usercmd and is not by itself proof of a physical local controller mapping.
limitations: All function addresses listed are x64 reference addresses and must not be used on PS3 PPU.
PS4/Xbox One observations do not prove PS3 behavior.
No Campaign/Multiplayer PS3 runtime ELF or Pad Probe logs have been supplied.
No native PS3 Campaign Local Client 1 or playable Player 2 is claimed.
